name: ODRL Constraint
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Constraint (leftOperand, operator, rightOperand or rightOperandReference, with optional dataType, unit and status) or LogicalConstraint combining constraints with exactly one of odrl:and, odrl:or, odrl:xone or odrl:andSequence. Operands and operators are open IRIs. Uses building blocks: odrlTerms (odrlProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
